O cartão Custo humano mostra o trabalho: The Human cost card shows the team's workload. The large number is the total number of requests closed during the period. "Wait in the human queue" measures how long the customer waited for someone on the team to act on conversations handed over by the agent; it shows "—" here because there were none during the period. The surrounding rows measure how many times the team had to intervene in each request, the wait for the slowest cases (p90), and how many requests had to be escalated to someone at a higher level. "Open requests without a next step" counts open conversations with nothing scheduled to happen: someone is waiting without anyone having agreed on what comes next. The last row shows the percentage of customer messages that waited more than 4 hours for a first reply.
O cartão Conversão põe os negócios ganho: The Conversion card puts won deals alongside the effort the customer had to make. "Turns until outcome (median)" shows how many messages, counting both sides, a typical conversation exchanged before it was closed. The two "Persistence" rows count how many times the agent contacted the customer again on its own; they are only measured for conversations that became agent cases, and show "—" here because there were none. "Opt-outs during the period" counts people who asked to stop receiving messages. "Conversations that faded into silence" shows, among conversations in which the clinic spoke, how many ended with the clinic sending the last message, the customer not replying for more than 72 hours, and no one closing the conversation.
Para conferir se as vendas estão chegand: To check whether sales are arriving without affecting your ad numbers, paste the code shown in Meta Events Manager into "Test code (optional)" and save. While this field is filled in, sales are marked as tests and do not count toward ad learning. After saving, a blue notice appears at the top of the screen as a reminder; in the screenshot, the code has not been saved yet. Finished checking? Delete the code and save again. Sales closed during the test appear in pending items as "Event received in test mode". After deleting the code, click "Check or try again" on each one so they count for real.
No topo aparecem o nome do cliente, um s: At the top are the customer's name, a badge indicating whether the conversation is open or finished, and who is handling it now: a person, automated support, or no one ("Unassigned"). The number the customer contacted also appears beside the name (here, "Recepção Bem Viver"). The buttons just below, such as Take over and Close, apply to this conversation. On the right, below the buttons, the "Automation paused" notice means automated support does not reply in this conversation. "Book service" schedules an appointment in the calendar, and "Mark as personal" removes the contact from the Inbox; the other buttons appear in the next lessons.
O quadro \"Detalhes\" mostra o código co: The "Details" panel shows the full code, type, status, where the request came from ("Source"), how many times the system tried to process it ("Attempts"), and the company. When something went wrong, a red "Error" box appears at the bottom of this panel. Here it says "email_not_configured": the file with the customer's data was generated, but the server does not have email sending configured, so it was not delivered to the customer. "Scope" indicates whether the request concerns one customer ("contact") or the entire store; "Slug" is the company's short name in the system address; "External customer ID" is the customer's number in Nuvemshop.
Clique no nome de uma etiqueta para abri: Click a tag's name to open the Inbox filtered by it, on the "All" tab. The selected tag appears in the tag filter. Note: the Inbox shows conversations with that tag from any date, as well as conversations with customers who have that tag on their customer record. This means more conversations may appear than the number in the table: here, "convenio" had 2 in the table and the Inbox shows 4. In the list, the tag below the name comes from the customer record. A tag applied only to a conversation does not appear there: open the conversation to see it under "Conversation tags".
\"Salvar\" grava os dados. Assim que o e: "Save" stores the settings. As soon as the server address and sender email are saved, all emails go through this server, even if a setting is wrong. "Test connection" logs in to your server with the username and password and tells you whether it worked, without sending any email. Note: the test checks what is already SAVED, not what you have typed. If nothing has been saved yet, it replies "Enter and save the server and sender before testing." If a server was already saved, it tests the old one. So save first, then test right away.
Quando uma mensagem não sai, ela ganha u: When a message fails to send, it gets a red border and the "Failed" badge beside the time. The reason appears just below. When the system does not know the reason, a general notice appears, as in the screenshot. Messages written by the team usually have a "Try again" button, which sends the same message again. If there is a chance it already reached the customer, the system asks for confirmation first. If resending would not help, such as for a number without WhatsApp, the button does not appear. AI replies do not get this button: the system itself retries.
Clicar numa linha leva você à tela com o: Clicking a row takes you to the problem details screen. Queue and AI alerts open that company's health page; LGPD alerts open the Admin "LGPD" screen. Here, the "AI budget" card shows this month's spending, which determines whether AI stops. It is at 0%: the alert's 87% referred to cumulative spending. The other yellow cards ("WAHA", "Nuvemshop", and "Audit Lag") only indicate that this example company has not connected those channels or recorded any activity yet; it is not a fault. To return to the dashboard, click "Dashboard" in the menu.
Ligando \"Só atender em horário de funci: Turning on "Only respond during business hours" reveals the time zone, start time, end time, and days of the week for support. It defaults to 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., Monday through Friday (shown as 08:00 AM and 08:00 PM on screen), and you can adjust it as you like. In "After-hours message", write the notice for people who contact the clinic when it is closed (the gray text in the field is just an example): it is sent once per customer during each closed period, and never to anyone who asked to stop receiving messages. To apply this, save the draft and publish.
A Inbox é onde você lê e responde os cli: The Inbox is where you read and reply to customers. The conversation list is on the left, the conversation you open appears in the middle, and the customer record is on the right. When you enter from the menu, it opens on the Queue tab, showing who is waiting for a person. Beside it are the Automated tab (conversations handled by automated support) and Mine (those assigned to you). In the row below, All, Closed, and Archived show all conversations, those already closed, and those stored outside the queue.
O cartão 'Situação da cobrança' diz se a: The 'Billing status' card indicates whether billing is running. The badge shows whether you are in 'TEST MODE' or 'PRODUCTION'. 'Last provider notification' is the last time the payment company sent a notification, such as a payment or new subscription. 'Last successful check' is the last time the system checked subscriptions on its own, which it does every 6 hours. If more than 7 hours pass without this check, the row turns red: automatic checking has stopped, and whoever manages your server needs to investigate.
\"O que o agente pode fazer\" define o q: "What the agent can do" defines what it does on its own during a conversation. Capabilities come in task packages, such as "Support and respond" and "Sell and move the pipeline": enabling a package enables all its capabilities at once. Those with an "Effect that cannot be undone" are in the red panel and can only be enabled one at a time. The counter shows how many are enabled. The limit is 27: beyond that, the agent gets confused when choosing what to use, so only enable the packages your business needs.
Mais abaixo ficam as ações. \"Compareceu: The actions are farther down. "Attended" and "No-show" record what happened and only work after the appointment has started. When the appointment has a customer and they notified you by message, select their message in "Customer message used as evidence (optional)" before clicking. "Remind in one hour" postpones the notice asking the team to record attendance by one hour. To cancel, enter a reason of at least 3 letters in "Cancellation reason" and click "Cancel appointment".
O primeiro quadro é o nome do sistema. S: The first panel is the system name. If the field is empty, the faint text inside it is the name currently in use. If the installation has already saved a name, it appears in the field. This name appears in the browser tab title, the sign-in screen, menus, and, when email sending is configured, emails from companies that have not chosen their own name. Leaving the field blank reverts to the name set during server installation or, if none was set, the default name.
O último cartão mostra os negócios ganho: The last card shows deals won over the past 30 days. The number in the title is the total wins for the entire clinic. The chart line goes through each day, and days without wins show zero so the dips do not disappear. Farther down, by scrolling, a table repeats the same numbers, period by period. The field to the right of the title, currently set to "Day", chooses whether wins are grouped by day, week, or month; the period remains the past 30 days. Click it.
Conexões é a tela dos canais por onde a: Connections is the screen for the channels the clinic uses to communicate with customers. Only administrators can open this screen. Tabs appear at the top, one for each channel type. The screen opens on "QR numbers", which are WhatsApp numbers connected by scanning a QR Code with a phone. The other tabs ("Official API (Meta)", "Partner provider", "Phone", "Social media", and "Voice call") appear in the last lesson. The red banner at the top appears when a number disconnects. It is explained in step 5.
Em \"Dias fora da rotina\", escolha \"Fe: Under "Days outside the routine", choose "Close the day", a date, and a reason, then click "Close this day". Note: the closed day applies only to the calendar of the person using the system, not the entire clinic. To close another manager's or administrator's calendar, they need to sign in with their own account and do the same. "Open for appointments" does the opposite: it opens a day outside working hours, such as a Saturday. "Repeat every week until" closes the same weekday until the selected date.
Quando a instalação termina, a lista se: When installation finishes, the list updates automatically: the card gets the "Installed" badge and the button disappears, as happened here with "Order tabs". If a system update ever fails to rebuild the module, the badge changes to red "Suspended", and its screens disappear from companies until a subsequent update succeeds. The reason appears just below the description as technical text: copy it and send it to whoever manages your server. This screen has no retry button.
A coluna \"Status\" diz se a chave ainda: The "Status" column indicates whether access is still valid. "Active": the person can enter Admin normally. "Revoked": access was removed and they can no longer enter Admin (they land on the access denied screen). The row does not disappear: it stays in the list, faded, as a record. Here, Marcos Teixeira, who managed the clinic's IT, has lost access. Note: the screen does not show when, by whom, or why access was removed. The row's "Reason" remains the reason given when access was granted.
O quadro de aviso, logo acima do \"Salva: The notice just above "Save" explains: if you replace credentials already in use, people who have connected their calendars may need to reconnect, because their previous authorizations were granted to the old application. No appointments are lost because of this. On the same row as "Save", to the left, "Never configured here." means no one has saved anything on this screen yet. After the first save, "Last changed on" appears there with the date and time.
Salvar não testa as informações com o Go: Saving does not test the information with Google: the real test is someone clicking "Connect Google" in Calendar. Before that, check in Google Cloud that the "Google Calendar API" is enabled (APIs & Services › Library), otherwise the connection is rejected. To change only the ID later, leave the secret blank: the existing one is kept. People with read-only Admin access receive the notice "Your platform administration access is read-only." and nothing is saved.
No botão de três pontinhos da linha fica: The row's three-dot button contains "Revoke access". After you confirm with "Revoke", the person can no longer enter this company, their open conversations return to the Queue unassigned, and they are removed from the list of people responsible for support numbers. Their row stays in the list with the "Revoked" badge. The system does not allow revoking the last Administrator. Here, just look: close with "Cancel". The notice says "tenant": that means this company.
\"Quem fez\" lista quem agiu no período: "Who did it" lists everyone who acted during the period (each team member, each AI agent, and automation), from most to fewest actions, with a count and a bar sized to their share. The symbol before the name indicates the type: a filled circle is a person, a ring is an agent, and a dashed circle is automation (the system or an automation). Beside it, "What was done" makes the same count by event type, such as "Changed stage" or "Took over the conversation".
\"Desconectar\" apaga na hora, sem pedir: "Disconnect" immediately deletes the stored token and selected default account without asking for confirmation. Nothing changes in your ad account, and no campaign numbers are lost: the system does not store these numbers; it only reads them from Meta when you open the screen. After that, the Meta Ads screen asks you to connect again. Note: the system never returns the token. To reconnect, you will need it; if you did not keep it, generate another in Meta for Developers.
No fim de cada linha há três atalhos. O: At the end of each row are three shortcuts. The eye opens the company's health page. The pencil opens its record, where you can also edit its details. The pause button opens confirmation to suspend the company without leaving the list. For a company suspended by an admin, it becomes a "Reactivate" button. If the company was suspended for nonpayment, it becomes a receipt icon leading to its record. For a redacted company, only the "View" link remains, opening its record.
Leia o aviso com atenção: a equipe da em: Read the notice carefully: the company's team loses access, and its AI, outgoing messages, and automations stop. Queued messages and scheduled tasks are discarded and will not be sent when it returns; ongoing follow-ups pause and resume where they left off when the company is reactivated. Incoming messages continue to be recorded. Enter a reason (at least 10 characters) and click "Confirm suspension". To back out, use "Cancel".
Role o quadro para o lado para ver as ou: Scroll the board sideways to see the other stages. In this pipeline, "In treatment", the third column, is the won stage: a card reaching it counts as a closed deal. "Canceled", the last column, is the lost stage. Columns saying "empty" do not have any cards yet. The top of the won and lost stages also shows the "weighted" value: in the won stage it equals the sum because the deal is already closed; in the lost stage it is zero.
Na aba \"Atendimento\", o quadro \"Modo: On the "Support" tab, the "Routing mode" panel determines who receives new conversations across the company. If a number has its own rule in Settings › Support distribution, that number's rule applies (that screen also shows this same mode under different names). Below is the list of support staff with each person's on-duty status, workload, and schedule. Managers and Administrators can make changes here; other roles only see a notice.
Cada linha é um aviso, da mais nova para: Each row is a notification, from newest to oldest (the last 20 appear). On the left is its type: "New appointment", "Rescheduled", "Canceled", or "Daily summary". On the right, the date and time the notification was sent (or recorded, if it was not sent). This is not the appointment time. Below are its outcome ("Sent", "Not sent", or "Included in the 7 a.m. summary") and the destination phone, with only its last four digits visible.
Na parte \"Conversa com o cliente\", o p: In the "Customer conversation" section, the first block is "Who this agent is". The "Name" is what appears in the agent list, and "Description" is your note about what it does. "Preference order" only matters when more than one agent can handle the same conversation: the one with the higher number tries first. With only one agent, leave it as it is. Note: these three fields take effect as soon as you save the draft, without needing to publish.
No mesmo WhatsApp também escrevem pessoa: People who are not customers also message the same WhatsApp: team members, partners, family, and suppliers. At the bottom of the screen is "Internal contact tags". A contact marked with one of these tags does not become a deal in the pipeline or receive AI replies. The conversation continues normally in the Inbox, and you can reply manually. In a new installation the field is empty: the gray "internal", "team", and "family" are just an example.
Com \"Deixar o agente pedir uma tarefa a: With "Let the agent request a task from someone", it opens an internal request, such as approving a discount, and keeps assisting the customer until someone responds. The "Sales proposals" switch lets it draft a proposal when the customer requests a quote. Under "Follow-up", it independently reaches out to people who stopped replying: the first switch lets it schedule new follow-ups, and the second enables automatic flows created on the Follow-ups screen.
Este quadro autoriza as chamadas de voz: This panel authorizes voice calls through the company's WhatsApp number. Read the yellow notice first: to make calls, the system connects a second device to the company number through a route that is not official WhatsApp, and WhatsApp may block the entire account. In this installation, a message says voice calling is not installed on the server: whoever manages the installation needs to enable it first.
O primeiro quadro é a \"Chave secreta do: The first panel is the "App secret", which you copy from Meta's dashboard. When empty, the field shows "32 letters and numbers", the secret's length. What you type appears as dots, and the secret is never displayed again after it is saved. Below, "Never configured here." means no one has saved anything on this screen yet. The "Save" button stays disabled until the field has at least 16 characters.
\"Incidents\" é a lista de incidentes: o: "Incidents" is the incident list: a place to record server problems that need an administrator's attention, such as a disconnected WhatsApp number. In this version, however, nothing in the system opens an incident automatically, so the list is empty in a new installation. The screen opens showing only open incidents, meaning those no one has resolved yet. The number in the list appears below the title.
O Atrito tem quatro cartões: Conversão,: Friction has four cards: Conversion, Automation, Human cost, and Containment. All are read the same way. On the left, in large text, is the result (here, "Won deals": how many deals were won in the last 30 days). On the right, under "What this cost", are measures of the price of that result. The two sides are deliberately kept together: a good number only counts if its cost is also good.
Em \"Nome\" fica o apelido que você deu: "Name" contains the nickname you gave the key. "Prefix" shows only its beginning: the system does not store the entire key, so this part lets you check which key a system is using. "Scopes" contains the key's permissions, with each one's short name. The AI assistant, for example, can read the CRM ("mcp:read"), act in it ("mcp:write"), and acts with manager privileges ("role:manager").
As frases em laranja embaixo do cartão d: The orange text below the card tells you what is missing. "The assistant cannot see anything in this database yet" means no tables have been allowed: the "Choose what it can read" link takes you straight to that choice. The second notice says that, in conversations, the assistant would query the database without limiting itself to the patient speaking. To fix this, use "Edit" and specify which column identifies the customer.
O botão \"Exportar CSV\", acima da tabel: The "Export CSV" button above the table downloads it as a spreadsheet, with one row per company and numbers for the selected period; the filename indicates the period, such as "usage-90d.csv". Open it in Google Sheets (File > Import). In Excel, use Data > From Text/CSV instead of double-clicking, otherwise everything ends up in a single column. Note: the "custo_reais" column is actually in dollars, as on the screen.
Nada disso vale até você clicar em \"Sal: None of this takes effect until you click "Save" at the bottom of the form. After clicking, "Brand saved." appears for a few seconds, and the name and color take effect on the sign-in screen and for companies that have not chosen their own branding. "Where each item comes from" changes to "set on this screen". The yellow line is a warning and does not prevent saving. If the color is entered incorrectly, the button stays disabled.
Os \"Freios de segurança\" limitam cada: "Safety brakes" limit each conversation. In "Actions per conversation", define how many actions the agent can perform in one reply, and in "Previous messages it reads", how much of the conversation it rereads before replying. Under "Wait before replying", customer messages sent in succession within this time receive a single reply. If left empty, the installation default applies.
Depois de salvar, o botão some e a medid: After saving, the button disappears and the measure on the Conversion card is renamed "Conversations that faded into silence (after 48h)", already counted using the new threshold. Here the number did not change because the only lost conversation had already been silent for more than 72 hours. The threshold applies across the company and also changes how past days are measured. To restore the default, enter 72 and save again.
Depois de salvar, o quadro \"Publicado\": After saving, the "Published" panel shows what was stored, grouping identical days: here, "Mon–Fri 08:00–18:00". Check before leaving and click "Close". From now on, Calendar shows these available times for Carlos. Remember that his "Available" switch is off: turn it on so he also receives conversations and can be booked for appointments configured as services.
Ainda não dá para enviar um arquivo do c: You cannot upload a file from your computer yet. To add a photo, paste the address of an image already on the internet and publicly accessible into "Avatar URL" (for example, the team photo on the clinic's website). Prefer an address starting with "https://". After saving, the photo appears in the circle in the top corner, replacing the initials. If it does not appear, reload the page.
O aviso azul explica que esta tela só mo: The blue notice explains that this screen is view-only. There is deliberately no button here to add, remove, or change anyone: access is granted or removed directly in the database by the technical person who manages the server database (the "DBA" in the notice), and the notice asks them to leave an explanatory note in the audit log. This prevents anyone from gaining access to all companies with one click.
Em \"Conexão que envia os avisos\" você: In "Connection that sends notifications", choose which clinic WhatsApp number sends the message. Only numbers that can send a message written on the spot without an approved template appear. Note: disconnected numbers also appear in the list, and notifications will not go through them. "Number receiving notifications" is the phone number of the person who wants to be notified, starting with +55 and the area code.
Cada empresa escolhe um teto de gasto co: Each company chooses an AI spending limit. This setting determines what happens when it exceeds it. "Respect each company's limit" is the default: each company's choice applies. "Only notify, never stop AI" notifies the company but lets AI keep replying. "Off" ignores the limit: no notification and no stop. This setting never enables protection for a company: it can only loosen it.
No fim da tela fica \"CSS personalizado\: At the bottom of the screen is "Custom CSS". This is for fine adjustments a designer writes in code: text color, rounded borders, typeface (only those already on the user's computer: you cannot load a new font). They apply on every screen, including sign-in, for all companies on the server. If you have no one to write this, you can leave it blank.
O botão \"Iniciar conversa\", no alto da: The "Start conversation" button at the top of the list lets you send the first message to a customer without waiting for them to write. The conversation opens assigned to you, and automated support does not reply in it. The exception is when another support staff member is already handling that number: then the conversation stays with them. To continue, click Mariana Souza's conversation, the first in the list.
O quadro \"Linha do tempo SLA\" mostra o: The "SLA timeline" panel shows the deadline as a bar. On the left is how many days ago the request arrived ("D+" and the number of days); on the right, how many days remain until the final deadline. The bar is green, turns yellow when three quarters of the time have passed, and red when it runs out. Reference stages appear below; each dot turns green once its date has passed.
A foto mostra a tela antes do cancelamen: The screenshot shows the screen before cancellation. After you confirm, the screen states the date through which you keep access, and the status text, currently "Up to date", changes to "Canceled, access until" that date. Until then, administrators see a banner at the top of the system: "Your subscription ends on" and the date. The "Change plan" and "Cancel subscription" buttons disappear.
Se não há ninguém disponível, o sistema: If no one is available, the system waits a few seconds and tries again. The "Backoff (s)" field sets the wait between attempts, initially 60. After the "Max. attempts" count (initially 5), the notice "A conversation is waiting for an assignee" appears in "Alerts" (the bell), and the system starts trying every 15 minutes. The "Save" button becomes enabled when you change something.
No alto da janela, em \"Tipo de resposta: At the top of the window, under "Quick reply type", click "Audio". The message field is replaced with "Audio file": choose the recording (OGG, MP3, AAC, AMR, or WAV, up to 16 MB). Audio replies have no text: in the Inbox, clicking opens "Send attachment" with the file ready, and you review it and click "Send". To listen beforehand, use the pencil here on this screen.
No alto do construtor ficam o nome do fl: At the top of the builder are the flow name, status, and buttons. The trigger button says what puts the patient into the flow. Here it is "Trigger: Silence (1440 min)": the patient enters 1440 minutes (one full day) after the last message they sent, even if the clinic has not replied. Beside it is the choice of what to do when a person takes over the conversation.
A terceira opção, \"Vai para quem tem me: The third option, "Goes to whoever has the fewest conversations", sends each new customer to the person with the fewest open conversations. If two people tie, it goes to whoever has gone longest without receiving one, as in round-robin. This is the best choice for a large team, where one overloaded person and another idle person are costly. Both attempt fields still apply.
Em cima fica o título do negócio e, logo: At the top is the deal title, with its value just below. The line with the speech bubble is the last message in the conversation with this customer: clicking it opens the conversation in the Inbox. The green number at the end of this line counts messages no one has read yet. Next are the contact's phone number, the assignee, and how long the card has been in this stage ("3h" means three hours).
Aqui você liga o CRM ao banco de dados d: Here you connect the CRM to the database of another system the clinic already uses, such as its appointment system or insurance provider directory. This only works with PostgreSQL or MySQL databases, and the CRM server must be able to reach that database over the network. The connection is read-only: nothing the agent does changes the source system. Each card in the list is a connection.
Clique em \"Criar lead\". O cartão apare: Click "Create lead". The card appears in the selected stage, with the value, phone number, and contact's latest conversation. The board scrolls down automatically to the new card; the others remain above. Since Beatriz does not yet have a regular person looking after her, it starts as "Unassigned". To choose who handles it, use the card menu, which you will learn about in the next lesson.
\"Sincronizar agenda\" traz os contatos: "Sync address book" imports contacts saved in the address book of the phone connected to the company's number, only those with WhatsApp. Existing contacts are not duplicated. At the end, the window shows how many were added and how many were left out. Pay attention to the triangle warning: the phone's personal contacts are also imported, and only people who have given permission may receive campaigns.
Escreva o telefone e clique em \"Salvar: Enter the phone number and click "Save test list". The panel closes and the card shows how many numbers are authorized. From then on, only these numbers receive automatic replies on this clinic number, provided an AI agent is published and linked to it. For other customers, the conversation arrives in the Inbox and the team replies.
A coluna \"Horário\" mostra a semana de: The "Schedule" column shows each person's working week. "Not published" means they do not have a schedule yet: if their switch is on, routing sends them conversations at any time, but Calendar offers no slots for booking with them. To set up Carlos's week, click the clock button ("Edit") on his row.
\"Renomear\" troca o nome do fluxo. \"Du: "Rename" changes the flow name. "Duplicate" creates a copy with "(copy)" in its name, always as a draft. "Export" downloads the flow in a file accepted by "Import flow", here or in another account. Em \"Perfil de interface\", \"Completa\": Under "Interface profile", "Full" shows every screen the role permits. "Simplified" keeps just daily work: Inbox, Calendar, Pipelines, Contacts, Tasks, and Connections, plus personal settings (Profile, Security, Notifications, and Mobile app), which never disappear. The interface only changes the menu: what the person can do is still defined by their role.
Em \"Novo plano\", escolha o plano que v: Under "New plan", choose the plan you want. Here we chose "Clínica Completa". Just below, the current and new plans appear side by side, with the price and limits for people, connected numbers, and AI per month. Only other plans offered by the system administrator appear, with the same billing frequency (monthly or annual) as the current plan.
No campo \"Actor (user ID)\" você cola o: In "Actor (user ID)", paste a person's full code to see only what they did; the code appears in the "Actor" column and on each event page. The two date fields limit the period: the first is the start and the second the end. When any filter is enabled, "Clear" appears, turning all filters off at once: companies, actions, person, and dates.
O primeiro quadro guarda o cadastro da s: The first panel stores your company details: the name the team sees, legal name, CNPJ, time zone, language, currency and country, data protection officer's email, privacy policy address, and how long to keep conversation photos and audio. Nothing changes until you click "Save" at the bottom of the panel.
Cada número diz, no próprio cartão, para: Each number's card says who AI replies to. Reception shows "AI open to the public": AI can assist anyone who writes.
